name: com.dethboy/vedetta
description: Pay-per-call crypto sentiment, divergence verdicts, and live analyst reads over x402 - USDC on Base, no signup, no API key. Bring your own wallet; payment is authentication.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex private key of the wallet paying USDC on Base (x402). Optional: without it, paid tools return the live 402 offer instead of paying. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

environmentVariables.name: VEDETTA_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Global price-cap override in USD; replaces the per-route listed-price caps
